faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.paragraph: Everything you need to know before committing capital to a livestock plan.

q1.question: How does livestock investment work?
q1.answer: You purchase livestock unit plans. Krishi allocates physical biological assets tag-linked under strict veterinary supervision and partner farmers who share final trade revenues.

q2.question: Is the estimated return guaranteed?
q2.answer: No. Livestock investments involve physical biological risk. Expected returns are seasonal market projections; actual returns are distributed upon optimized sale.

q3.question: What happens if an animal becomes sick?
q3.answer: Each unit carries custom insurance. Our reserve fund covers treatment costs and certified veterinarians intervene immediately under Steward monitoring.

q4.question: How are care expenses approved?
q4.answer: Farmers must upload diagnostic verification or photo logs of feed requirements, vetted by digital stewards before escrow release.

q5.question: When do I receive my returns?
q5.answer: At the end of the predefined plan maturation cycle (e.g. 6 months for cow fattening), the asset is traded and capital + profits settle directly to your Krishi wallet.

q1.question: What is an investment unit?
q1.answer: An investment unit represents a single share in a specific, physical biological livestock animal. Your unit is securely back-allocated on our digital ledger to ensure strict 1-to-1 asset tracking.

q2.question: Are estimated returns guaranteed?
q2.answer: No. Livestock investments carry biological risk, meaning that disease, climate, or trade index shifts can impact yields. Estimates are based strictly on historical regional performance.

q3.question: How is my livestock tracked?
q3.answer: Each animal carries a custom biosecure RFID ear tag. Stewards use these tags to physically match, record weights, log vet checks, and authorize monthly escrow payouts.

q4.question: Who takes care of the livestock?
q4.answer: Daily custody and care are handled by vetted partner farmers with certified grassland facilities, overseen by professional veterinary Stewards.

q5.question: How are expenses approved?
q5.answer: Farmers upload digital invoices and weight certificates inside our portal. Veterinarian Stewards manually inspect these claims before any escrow care capital is authorized.

q6.question: When is profit calculated?
q6.answer: Net profits are finalized only at the maturation sale point, calculated directly as final marketplace sale revenue minus total purchase and care ledger costs.

q7.question: How can I withdraw funds?
q7.answer: At maturation settlement, your principal capital and profit shares settle directly into your Krishi wallet, allowing checkout to verified Bangladeshi banks or mobile wallets.

deathGuide: Don't move, sell or bury the body before taking photos.
Take a clear photo of the body that shows the ear tag.
Call your steward or a vet. If a vet examines it, photograph the certificate.
Report it here the same day. Your steward checks it and confirms.
If it may be a disease, keep the other animals away and follow the vet's advice on burial.
